Alger, 22 juillet 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, July 22, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Major malfunctions affect the Facebook, Messenger and Instagram platforms this July 22. Thousands of users are reporting problems accessing or connecting to applications.
Les utilisateurs des réseaux sociaux Fac: Users of the social networks Facebook, Messenger and Instagram are experiencing significant technical problems on July 22. Several reports have been reported on the DownDetector site, citing difficulties in connecting or accessing services. Meta, owner of the platforms, indicated that it was working to resolve the incidents.
Les internautes rapportent des situation: Internet users report varied situations: unexpected disconnections, inability to open applications or limited access to functionalities. These disruptions, although temporary, disrupt the experience of millions of users accustomed to these services.
Meta a appelé les utilisateurs à patient: Meta called on users to wait a few minutes before trying again, confirming that technical teams were intervening to restore normal operation. No time estimate has been provided for the definitive resolution of the problems.
